summary: 0 of 15 gradeable live rental(s) show a GPU line differing from the bid agreed at rental (10 of 25 carry no recorded bid and cannot be graded). No graded rental's GPU rate has moved from its bid. An apparent rise on the board is an INSTANCE's `dph_total` (bid + the real volume's disk line) read against an OFFER's `dph_total` (market floor + the disk line the search priced) — two different quantities, not a price move.
